_meta.note: Junior 'Researchers' deck. Total pips 3-6, per-skill 0-3, cost = total pips (3-7). earnableBoxes:2 (the 3-box display has box 1 pre-filled; 2 earnable, +1 to all skills each, 4 uses to max). Professions: 6 Historian / 6 Engineer / 6 Physicist, each with one 'brave' Grit-spiked member. Calibrated to sim postdoc bounds.

cards.name: Dr. Elena Foss
cards.flavour: Archivist's daughter; reads dead hands like print.

cards.name: Dr. Mira Castellanos
cards.flavour: Palaeographer who never met a cipher she liked losing to.

cards.name: Dr. Tomás Bly
cards.flavour: Field historian; happiest where the records are on fire. (Brave.)

cards.name: Dr. Priya Anand
cards.flavour: Conservator-historian; she can date a varnish by smell.

cards.name: Dr. Kwame Osei
cards.flavour: Maritime historian; chased the Franklin wrecks for real, once.

cards.name: Jun Park
cards.flavour: Apprentice machinist; learns a lock by listening to it.

cards.name: Sam Whitlock
cards.flavour: Keeps the Stabiliser honest; keeps the coffee strong.

cards.name: Dr. Yusuf Demir
cards.flavour: Structural engineer; the one who braces the stair as it goes. (Brave.)

cards.name: Greta Ohms
cards.flavour: Electrician by trade; calm in a room full of arcs.

cards.name: Dr. Rosa Lind
cards.flavour: Built half the modules on your machine; resents the other half.

cards.name: Dr. Nadia Voss
cards.flavour: Salvage engineer; can open anything frozen, flooded, or buried.

cards.name: Dr. Inés Marlow
cards.flavour: Postdoc on the original team; she did the maths that started all this.

cards.name: Dr. Lena Hartmann
cards.flavour: Reads instability like weather; trusts the Capacitor more than people.

cards.name: Dr. Cyrus Vale
cards.flavour: Tests his own theories in the field, which terrifies the funders. (Brave.)

cards.name: Dr. Owen Tsai
cards.flavour: Experimentalist; happiest soldering at 3 a.m. with the door open.

cards.name: Dr. Felix Brandt
cards.flavour: Theory man. Will explain the wavefunction whether you asked or not.

cards.name: Dr. Mei Lin
cards.flavour: The all-rounder; the one you send when you can only send one.
